metadata.description: Executable research artifact for composing an AI-agent Permit, an exact RIPE Atlas request, platform-assigned measurement effects, captured evidence, a bounded claim, and ordered first-bad-edge verification. The v0.1 corpus contains 21 matched positive/negative pairs plus one unpaired clean baseline, a 448-variation deterministic mutation sweep, and one prospective eight-measurement trace. Local signed JSON is a research profile, not a SCITT or RATS conformance claim.
metadata.notes: Code is Apache-2.0; manuscript, documentation, and public data are CC BY 4.0. The release excludes secret keys and raw address-bearing RIPE rows.
metadata.title: From Permit to Packet: Composing Agent Authority with Public Internet Measurement Evidence
